text: Good evening. I'm looking after my grandson tonight, he is 7. His temperature is 37.8. I noticed some marks coming up this evening. His skin is dark so it's hard to pick anything out on his body, so I checked the paler places, his palms, the bottoms of his feet and inside his lower eyelids. There are small dark red and purplish spots there. I pressed the side of a glass on them and they don't fade at all. The other thing is he hasn't been to the toilet for a wee since this morning, I've been keeping track and it's been over 12 hours now with nothing. I'm not one to panic but I'd like to know what you advise.
